failure_mode_definitions.DEVICE_RESOLUTION: Evaluator failed to recognize the device in the patent text
failure_mode_definitions.MECHANISM_RESOLUTION: Evaluator failed to recognize the mechanism in the patent text
failure_mode_definitions.RELATIONSHIP_RESOLUTION: Evaluator failed to recognize the functional relationship between device and mechanism
failure_mode_definitions.CLAIM_SCOPE_RESOLUTION: Evaluator misread the scope of the patent claim
failure_mode_definitions.CROSS_SECTION_INFERENCE: Evaluator failed to bridge information across different sections of the patent
failure_mode_definitions.PROMPT_FAILURE: Evaluator was correctly applying its prompt but the prompt was insufficient
failure_mode_definitions.ORACLE_INVALID: The oracle label itself is wrong — the patent does not actually disclose what the oracle claims

per_case_failure_modes.reason: The patent text only describes a contact lens treating solution containing antimicrobial agents; it never mentions intraocular lenses or an antimicrobial coating applied to such lenses. Therefore, the oracle’s claim of SPECIFIC_DISCLOSURE for an intraocular lens with an antimicrobial coating is not supported by the patent.
per_case_failure_modes.evaluator_behavior: CORRECT — the evaluator correctly returned NOT_SPECIFIC_DISCLOSURE because the claimed device and mechanism are absent from the patent text.
per_case_failure_modes.oracle_behavior: INCORRECT — the oracle label is wrong because the patent does not actually disclose an intraocular lens or an antimicrobial coating on it.

per_case_failure_modes.reason: The patent text describes a generic "object information acquiring apparatus" with a probe and delay-and-sum units, but never mentions "ultrasound" or "transducer." The oracle's claim that the device is an "Ultrasound System" is not supported by the patent text, so the oracle label is incorrect.
per_case_failure_modes.evaluator_behavior: CORRECT — the evaluator correctly determined that the patent does not specifically disclose an ultrasound system, as the text lacks any explicit or implicit reference to ultrasound.
per_case_failure_modes.oracle_behavior: INCORRECT — the oracle incorrectly labeled the case as SPECIFIC_DISCLOSURE despite the patent not disclosing the claimed device class.

per_case_failure_modes.reason: The patent text mentions ultrasound systems and volumetric ultrasound images but never discloses a “transducer” or any functional relationship involving a transducer. The oracle label therefore claims a specific disclosure that the patent does not actually support, making the oracle label itself incorrect.
per_case_failure_modes.evaluator_behavior: CORRECT — the evaluator correctly returned NOT_SPECIFIC_DISCLOSURE because the patent text lacks the claimed mechanism and relationship.
per_case_failure_modes.oracle_behavior: INCORRECT — the oracle labeled the case as SPECIFIC_DISCLOSURE even though the patent text does not disclose the transducer mechanism.

per_case_failure_modes.reason: The patent text exclusively describes methods for reducing apoptosis using ACCS from AMP cells, with no mention of coronary stents or drug-eluting coatings. The oracle's label of SPECIFIC_DISCLOSURE is unsupported by the disclosed content, making the oracle label itself incorrect.
per_case_failure_modes.evaluator_behavior: CORRECT — the evaluator correctly identified that the patent does not disclose the claimed device and mechanism.
per_case_failure_modes.oracle_behavior: INCORRECT — the oracle's label is wrong because the patent does not disclose a coronary stent with a drug-eluting coating.

per_case_failure_modes.reason: The patent text exclusively describes dental care compositions, silicone resins/gums, and teeth colour modifying substances, with no mention of a continuous glucose monitor or biocompatible membrane. The oracle label asserting SPECIFIC_DISCLOSURE is therefore unsupported by the actual patent content.
per_case_failure_modes.evaluator_behavior: CORRECT — the evaluator correctly returned NOT_SPECIFIC_DISCLOSURE because the claimed device and mechanism are absent from the patent.
per_case_failure_modes.oracle_behavior: INCORRECT — the oracle label is wrong because the patent does not disclose a continuous glucose monitor or biocompatible membrane.

evaluator_change_rationale: The evaluator was CORRECT in 100% of the 5 positive cases. The 'failures' reported in V4 (0/5 SPECIFIC_DISCLOSURE recognition) are not evaluator failures — they are oracle labeling failures. Per spec Section 6, when positives are mostly C/D, the oracle must be fixed, not the evaluator.

condition_a_vs_b_vs_c_agreement.note: All three evaluator conditions agree on all 5 cases — none recognize the labeled intervention as SPECIFIC_DISCLOSURE.
